suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-5 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Require documented celiac disease and separately established osteoporosis. Treat the source as population-level association/risk evidence rather than proof that celiac disease caused osteoporosis in an individual. Preserve age, sex/menopausal status, body mass, vitamin D/calcium status, glucocorticoid exposure, smoking, endocrine or renal disease, and other established osteoporosis causes or contributors. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
